paper_title: Axion and neutrino bounds improved with new calibrations of the tip of the red-giant branch using geometric distance determinations
notes: Stellar (red-giant tip) bound on axion-electron coupling, mass-independent for light axions. Best 95% CL bound g_ae < 1.3e-13 from omega Centauri (g13 = 1.29 in Table I); NGC 4258 gives g_ae < 1.6e-13. Encoded the strongest bound as mass-independent horizontal line. The bound applies for axion masses well below the core temperature (~keV). | selector: table (sole candidate)
